summary: Iteration 2 backend testing: Quotation Builder endpoints 100% pass (7/7). Milestone Tracker endpoints 0% pass (5/5 fail) — three required backend endpoints are MISSING entirely from server.py: GET /api/orders/{order_id}, PATCH /api/admin/orders/{order_id}/milestones, and PATCH /api/admin/orders/{order_id}. This blocks the entire OrderDetail.jsx page and the Create-order→Order workspace flow. Frontend E2E for order workspace was not executed because backend is broken; regression pages still load.

critical.issue: Endpoint does not exist in server.py. Returns 404 Not Found. Required by test spec (admin=200, buyer-owner=200, other-buyer=403) and by frontend OrderDetail.jsx (api.get(`/orders/${id}`)). Must fetch order by order_id, enforce RBAC: admin ok, buyer ok iff order.rfq_id belongs to their company (join via rfqs.buyer_company_id), else 403.

Endpoint missing (404). Frontend OrderDetail.setMilestone calls it and expects the updated order back. Should replace order.milestones with body['milestones'] and return the full updated order doc (sans _id).

Endpoint missing (404). Frontend OrderDetail.setOrderStatus calls it. Should update arbitrary allowed fields (status etc.), insert an activity_logs entry (kind='order_update', order_id, by, changes, at), and return the updated order.

minor.issue: Ignores role check that rfq_id may be None — when buyer calls without rfq_id it returns ALL buyer_quotations across all buyers (no ownership filter in that branch, line ~488). Consider always filtering by rfqs owned by buyer_company_id.

AdminQuotationCreate inherits QuotationCreate which requires `quantity` field. Frontend Compare form's `q-add` sends quantity possibly empty; passes because pydantic accepts empty string. OK but consider Optional to avoid future validation surprises.

integration_issues.issue: OrderDetail page will render 'Loading…' forever because GET /api/orders/{id} returns 404. Depends on backend fix.
Same as above — buyer dashboard order click-through blocked by missing GET /api/orders/{id}.

action_items: Add GET /api/orders/{order_id} with RBAC (admin=200; buyer 200 iff rfq belongs to their company_id else 403; exporter 200 iff exporter_company_id matches else 403).
Add PATCH /api/admin/orders/{order_id}/milestones (admin only) — replace order.milestones and return updated order.
Add PATCH /api/admin/orders/{order_id} (admin only) — $set allowed fields (status, exporter_company_id, total_price, currency, notes), insert activity_logs entry, return updated order.
Consider hardening GET /api/quotations for buyer role when rfq_id is None (currently exposes cross-buyer buyer_quotations).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py — the entire order lifecycle backend has POST + GET-list only; 3 endpoints referenced by frontend are absent. This is a spec/implementation mismatch, not just a bug.

list_buyer_quotations (line ~522): correctly strips internal_costs/internal_notes for buyer role and correctly enforces buyer_company_id ownership + status in ('published','sent','accepted'). Verified via tests.
admin_create_quotation persists created_by_admin=True and exporter_name — good.
OrderDetail.jsx uses cookie-based /orders/{id} via `api` axios client. Once backend is added, buyer-side view will work; ensure exporter role is not confused (RBAC path).
PATCH /admin/buyer-quotations/{bqid} accepts a raw dict — consider a Pydantic model + whitelist to prevent overwriting created_at/buyer_quotation_id (currently manually pops these — acceptable).

rca of the issue: server.py currently defines only @api.post('/admin/orders') (line 568) and @api.get('/orders') (line 576). The frontend OrderDetail.jsx and AdminRfqWorkspace.jsx were built against a spec that requires three additional order endpoints. Root cause: backend implementation is incomplete for the milestone-tracker feature added in iteration 2. Mitigation: add the three endpoints per action_items above, then rerun pytest — all 12 tests should pass.
